description: Returns a list of reviews for tracks with various filtering options. Since February 2021 the boolean field 'track_audiodownload_allowed' indicates whether the track can be downloaded through your application. In April 2022 the 'track_audiodownload' field will be an empty string when 'track_audiodownload_allowed' is false. Pagination parameters, ordering, and optional OAuth2 access token are supported.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback function; only works with json format GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append _asc or _desc to indicate direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' header with total rows ignoring limit/offset. Affects performance.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Closed interval for review dates in the form yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: One or more user IDs (no access token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: hasscore
parameters.description: Filter reviews that have (or do not have) a score.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field; defaults to mp31.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field; defaults to audioformat or mp32.

responseFields.name: agreecnt
responseFields.description: Number of agreements on the review.

responseFields.name: user_id
responseFields.description: ID of the user who wrote the review.

responseFields.name: track_audiodownload_allowed
responseFields.description: Indicates if the track can be downloaded through the application.

responseFields.name: track_audiodownload
responseFields.description: URL for audio download; empty string if download is not allowed.

responseFields.name: audio
responseFields.description: URL for audio streaming in the requested audioformat.

notes: The 'track_audiodownload_allowed' field was added in Feb 2021; use it to decide whether to present a download option.
As of Apr 2022 the 'track_audiodownload' field will be empty when download is not allowed, regardless of the 'audiodlformat' parameter.
'fullcount' adds a results_fullcount header but can degrade performance on heavy queries.
'limit' accepts the keyword 'all' but still caps results at 200 rows.
Ordering fields support an optional _asc or _desc suffix; the default direction is ascending.
If 'callback' is supplied it only works with format=json or jsonpretty; otherwise it is ignored and a warning is issued.
